title: Loki: When coalescing adjacent text nodes in addText and fosterParent, appending to an existing TextNode's Data via…
description: CVE-2026-78661 is a high-severity vulnerability in the Loki software affecting multiple versions prior to their respective fixed releases. The flaw involves the handling of adjacent text nodes during operations like addText and fosterParent, where appending to an existing TextNode's Data via string concatenation can lead to a security issue. The vulnerability has been addressed in versions 3.5.12-r9, 1.8.0-r3, 1.9.0-r1, 1.11.1-r6, and 1.9.1-r7.
